purpose: Determine how many frozen long-term Adelie sites can be independently validated against the published Schwaller et al. Landsat-7 guano-pixel reference before any new guano classifier or demographic outcome is opened.

reference.dataset: Schwaller, Southwell & Emmerson 2013 classified Adelie penguin colonies from Landsat data
reference.content: classified Landsat-7 ETM+ colony pixels with colony ID, source scene, classification d-value, row/column, latitude/longitude and spectral bands

feasibility_gate.meaning: enough independent published reference overlap to justify a frozen classifier-recovery exercise; not evidence that a new classifier already works

outputs: candidate-site to nearest published reference-colony distance
published reference colony pixel count and nominal 30 m footprint area
prohibited: tuning the match radius after demographic outcomes
stop_rule: If the reference-overlap gate fails, do not lower the 5 km radius after looking at demographic outcomes; use a different independent recovery source or stop the Landsat-guano classifier route.
